title: Pre-ledger audit: August 2026 geomagnetic watch verification
method: Hand-audit of G1+ storm expectations relayed from public space-weather forecasts (EarthSky, Met Office, NOAA SWPC watches) vs the observed Kp record (XRAS/GFZ historical calendar).

result.note: Systematic over-forecasting: possibility language ('chance of G1') relayed as expectation. This finding motivated the ledger.

lesson: A WATCH is not a prediction. The ledger separates OBSERVED / WATCH / MODEL / PROB claim types and scores each on its own terms.
